gate_coverage.failure_evidence: guide_failure_consultation in BATCH.json or unique immutable FATAL receipt after bounded owned-worker shutdown

limitations: The gate covers the prospective receipt-repair launcher, not all historical launchers or direct runner execution.
A caller can assert acknowledgment without comprehension; an owner changing code/current manifest or using a different launcher can bypass this software policy. It is not an OS security boundary.
No durable receipt can be guaranteed on unwritable/full storage. Failed guide loading during failure handling is recorded as guide_consultation_error where receipt storage remains available.
Pre-gate/config errors before a batch exists and errors in final lock-release are surfaced to the owner; task-start/blocker instruction requires manual incident consultation for these.
Nonzero child exit uses the generic preservation rule; no unsupported classification of child stderr.

limits_source.explicit_current_denial: Requested additional20minutes and192MiB denied/pending Ben approval; treating earlier caps as agent estimates does not bypass this denial.

remaining_dependencies: Explicit approval of denied expansion if that recovery plan is chosen.
Reconcile full-run measured timing, endpoint overhead and checkpoint atomic/storage headroom inside actual authorized resources.
No midpoint checkpoint implemented; retained original40 parents intact, both partial fits have no saved new checkpoint.
Future PC package/config/request must pin recovery_guide.py and the exact current guide and include matching task acknowledgment; no deployment done.

failure.action: Stop only owned child; preserve durable artifacts; consult current guide; diagnose narrowly and repair within authority. No automatic scientific retry or denied resource expansion.
failure.prepared: bounded receipt helper, unique immutable fallback, conservative storage census, guide consultation and retained failure artifacts

result_dependent_next_actions.independent_blocked_branch: This requested CPU-only guide integration and documentation is completed; no unrelated work queued.

success.action: After all four fixed endpoints close, independently recount saved artifacts and paired dev counts; report limited POC only according to frozen analysis.
